product.title: Everglades National Park Naturalist Led Hike, 2 Boat Trips + More

description.text: Discover the Florida Everglades with a guide who’s either a certified master naturalist or a trained biologist on this small-group tour that combines hiking with boat trips. Hotel pickup is included for added convenience.An Everglades tour that includes lunch and hotel pickup Explore nature in an intimate group of no more than 14 A great experience for nature Equipment, safety briefings, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on dolphins, shelling beaches, and Everglades wildlife. Ideal for Naples travelers who want a guided Everglades outing with transport, mangrove channels, and expert naturalist commentary included.
